note: A manual float PIN floats an otherwise-tileable window. Windows 20 and 21 are both standard+resizable (normally managed). The rules carry a runtime float pin {window_id:20, manage:"off"} — the synthesized rule `wm parcel float` appends last. Last-match-wins makes 20's verdict "off", so partition drops it to the float bucket; 21 (unpinned) stays managed. Proves a window_id-faceted off-rule is the manual override the S5 verb rides on.
